description: Extra Battle Master maneuvers are priced by compute() on an escalating rung: base + step*n for the nth extra purchase, so three cost 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 (DATA.maneuverBuy = {base:4, step:1}). Before D-GH-2026-08-06-maneuver-afford-gate's superseding answer, compute() never read maneuverBuys at all: the ledger could not explain the spend, the Live Sheet needed a bespoke pricing escape for its affordability gate to work, and repriceDraft() rewrote all three frozen costs to 0 while KEEPING the maneuvers - silently handing 15 AP back on a CharGen round-trip. This fixture exists because no fixture carried maneuverBuys at all until now, so the whole category had zero coverage while the suite reported green - the same blind spot that hid the Grit and Vigor ladders. The 'Extra maneuvers' ledger line must read 15.
